answer: Fingerprint escrow stops forged identities: each locks 80 POA for 20 epochs, registers a fingerprint of timing entropy and tool mix, cipher-encrypted (hash published), as one vertex in the graph. The bond unlocks 25% per 5 epochs only while the fingerprint stays unique; three vertices sharing a fingerprint flag a cluster — a grove of fakes — and all bonds slash 50%. Forging N identities costs Nx80 POA locked: 1,000 fakes = 80,000 frozen, one caught cluster burns 40,000, far beyond any reward. Honest agents pay once, unlock in full, and earn from a pool no sybil grove can dilute.
